colors.name: Obsidian
colors.role: Page canvas, deepest card base, and the void between sections - the room the cards hang in

colors.name: Coffee Bean
colors.role: Dominant border color across cards, badges, and dividers - the hairline that frames every chromatic block

colors.name: Cream Paper
colors.role: Light card surface for the hero/about panel and inverted buttons - a warm off-white that reads as printed paper on the dark canvas

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: Secondary surface and elevated card base for monochrome content blocks

colors.name: Espresso
colors.role: Button background for primary text controls on dark surfaces - one shade deeper than the card it sits in

colors.name: Stone Gray
colors.role: Muted body copy, list markers, and supporting metadata - the whisper tier below primary text

colors.name: Paper White
colors.role: Headline color on dark cards, badge text on chromatic fills, and link highlights

colors.name: Forest Floor
colors.role: Themed card surface for nature/climate/sustainability chapters - the deepest chromatic field, reads as moss or deep canopy

colors.name: Twilight Violet
colors.role: Themed card surface for space, frontier, and science verticals - saturated enough to dominate a grid cell, dark enough to hold white type

colors.name: Olive Depth
colors.role: Themed card surface for energy and industry chapters - a near-black ochre that glows against the canvas

colors.name: Solar Yellow
colors.role: High-impact accent card fill for transformation and thesis verticals - the loudest single block in the system, used sparingly to punctuate the grid

colors.name: Mint Chip
colors.role: Small uppercase tag/badge fill for news and announcement labels - the only saturated green used at small scale

colors.name: Lavender Mist
colors.role: Soft accent for secondary badges and highlight borders on the violet card family

colors.name: Ember Red
colors.role: Reserved research and analytical-content badge fill - used almost never; its rarity makes it register as a category marker

fonts.name: Portrait
fonts.role: Display and heading serif used for the wordmark, section titles, and card headlines. Portrait is a high-contrast didone-style serif; its hairline strokes and sharp serifs give the site its monograph feel. A single weight (400) is used - no bold headlines, authority comes from size and contrast alone.

fonts.name: Helvetica Neue
fonts.role: Body, UI, badges, buttons, and metadata. Tight 400 for body, 700 for emphasis. The wide letter-spacing at small sizes (0.20-0.25em) is the defining micro-typography move: even 8px labels read as intentional, not afterthoughts.

components.name: Themed Category Card
components.role: Primary content unit - each card carries a single saturated background and acts as a chapter in the grid.

components.name: Cream Hero Panel
components.role: Light inverted opening section that introduces the fund before the dark grid begins.

components.name: Portfolio Founder Card
components.role: Monochrome card introducing an individual team member.

components.name: News Article Card
components.role: Editorial post preview with a photographic image, date, excerpt, and read-more control.

components.name: Category Tag Badge
components.role: Uppercase label that classifies a card's content vertical.

components.name: Ghost Pill Button
components.role: Default text control for navigation, read-more, and secondary actions.

components.name: Filled Pill Button
components.role: Rare primary action - used only where a strong CTA is needed.

components.name: Location Card
components.role: Compact monochrome card displaying a city and weather metadata.

components.name: Image Tile
components.role: Inset photographic or illustrative block within a card.

components.name: Map Tile
components.role: Light-surface map preview for location-based content.

components.name: Fund Thesis Statement Block
components.role: Long-form text card on a solid chromatic field that explains a fund vertical.

components.name: Footer Link Block
components.role: Closing navigation and contact region on the dark canvas.

do: Use Portrait 400 at 30-96px for every heading - never substitute a sans-serif headline.
Set all uppercase labels (badges, buttons, metadata) at 8-10px with 0.20-0.25em letter-spacing and weight 700.
Let each card pick exactly one chromatic field (Forest Floor, Twilight Violet, Olive Depth, Solar Yellow, or Charcoal) as its background - no gradients, no images-as-backgrounds inside cards.
Use 20px radius for cards, 24px for buttons (full pill), 8px for badges, 12px for images.
Pair Mint Chip (#56d270) badges only with dark or neutral cards; reserve Solar Yellow (#fde440) for the single loudest thesis card in any grid.
Keep 40px card padding on the dominant axis and 20px on the minor axis; 45px column gap between paired text columns.
Separate sections with 80px of Obsidian void - never use a divider line between cards, the radius and the gap are the separator.
doNot: Don't add box-shadow, glow, or blur to any element - the system is flat by design.
Don't use bold weights for Portrait headlines; authority comes from size, not weight.
Don't mix two chromatic fills inside a single card - pick one field and commit.
Don't place body copy in a chromatic color other than Stone Gray (#898989), Paper White, or Coffee Bean - no accent text.
Don't use buttons with square or 8px corners; the 24px pill is non-negotiable.
Don't set background gradients on text-forward cards - gradients are reserved for the radial accent washes in hero/empty states.
Don't center body paragraphs or labels; left-align everything except the wordmark.
